# strings

Published version: `cli/strings@0.1.6`. See the release inventory;
[latest.json](../../tests/release/latest.json) records the uploaded coordinates.

Extract printable byte sequences for MoonX.

```sh
moonx cli/strings@0.1.6 [OPTION]... [FILE]...
```

## Supported scope

Scan complete files or stdin for runs of at least four printable bytes by default. TAB belongs to a printable run.

## Options

<!-- BEGIN GENERATED OPTIONS -->
<!-- Generated by tools/metadata from options.json. -->

| Option | Value | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `-a` / `--all` | none | scan the whole file |
| `-f` / `--print-file-name` | none | print the file name before each string |
| `-n` / `--bytes` | required | print sequences at least N bytes long Default: `4`. |
| `-o` / `--octal` | none | Print each string's byte offset in octal. |
| `-t` / `--radix` | required | display offsets in d, o, or x radix Default: `""`. |
| `-e` / `--encoding` | required | s: 7-bit bytes (default); S: 8-bit bytes |
| `-s` / `--output-separator` | required | separate accepted strings with STR Default: `"\n"`. |
| `--help` | none | Show help / package version. |
| `--version` | none | Show help / package version. |
<!-- END GENERATED OPTIONS -->

## Extension and diagnostic contract

Project alias: --octal selects -o; it is not a binutils long option.

See [the finite option and diagnostic profile](../../docs/compatibility.md#extensions-and-diagnostics) for the scope and upstream distinction.

## Argument and exit-status contract

Unknown encoding selectors exit 1; recognized unsupported wide encodings explicitly exit 2.

See the [finite diagnostic profile](../../docs/compatibility.md#extensions-and-diagnostics).

## Limitations

- Wide encodings, object-section selection, locale decoding and GNU Unicode rendering modes are unsupported.

## Examples

```sh
moonx cli/strings@0.1.6 -n 6 -t d data.bin
printf 'hello\000world\n' | moonx cli/strings@0.1.6
```
